title: 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair
place_text: Skywatcher site, about 6 km to the north and south

tellings.quote: received, and then in in February for the first time saw how two " "Jellyfish" fly together on the radar

plain: In February 2025, objects nicknamed "Jellyfish" for their shape were seen probing a radar beam, and for the first time two of them were seen flying together, about 6 km north and south of the site. This comes from the team at Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, speaking as witnesses watching their own radar. If true, it would mean the objects come in groups and react to being watched.
